paragraphs: An owner signs in with a one-time SMS code, manages employees, assigns tasks on a live kanban board, plans weekly schedules, and chats with the team in real time. Employees onboard from an email link, sign in with a password or a one-time email code, keep their profile up to date, and move their tasks to Done.
Live app: · API: (free tier: the first request after a quiet spell can take 30 s while the server wakes up)
features: Owner sign-in with phone + 6-digit SMS code (CreateNewAccessCode, ValidateAccessCode); the code is cleared after use.
Employee management: add (sends a setup email), edit, delete, search; GetEmployee, CreateEmployee, DeleteEmployee.
Employee onboarding through a secure single-use link; sign-in with username + password or a 6-digit email code (LoginEmail, ValidateAccessCode).
